notes: Gavel (GAVL) and LotAuction are intended for Sepolia. Deploy LaunchToken first, then LotAuction with the launch token as its immutable bidding currency. Both constructors are nonpayable; no initialization calls or application funding at deployment are required. LotAuction has no owner or administrative role and uses pull-based GAVL withdrawals and ERC-20 lot claims. The pool pairs GAVL with native Sepolia ETH and has no hook. initialPrice is decimal sqrtPriceX96; the deployer derives the effective opening price from the pinned policy when it specifies initialMarketCapWei. Policy, signed artifact linkage, admission and deployment are service responsibilities.
